## About
Twins Auto Body & Paint is named after the owner's twin sons. We fix and paint cars and trucks of every make and model, with the goal of getting each one back to pre-accident condition.
Our shop sits centrally in the San Fernando Valley, close to the freeways and near major car rental companies. Some of our workers have been with us for years, and we care more about doing each job right than doing a lot of them.
Customers know Mehdi by name. A reviewer told us they have been a loyal customer for years, and another trusted us with a tricky door repair on a Tesla Model X.

## Services
- Collision repair: On-the-spot diagnosis of collision damage and an estimate for the repair, on all makes and models, including fiberglass and aluminum bodies.
- Paint for cars and trucks: We paint cars, trucks, race cars and custom body kits in our heated paint booth.
- Color matching: We mix paint by hand to match your car's existing finish.
- Towing: Towing is available around the clock, 24 hours a day.
- Free pick-up and delivery: We can pick up and deliver your car for free in our part of Los Angeles County.
- Free car wash and detailing: Cars we repair get a free wash and detailing before they go home.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept major credit cards.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models, including cars with fiberglass and aluminum bodies.

Q: Can I get a rental car while mine is in the shop?
A: We are close to major car rental companies, and some offer discounted rates for our customers.
